prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Your Companion to Your Desktop", "Your companion is ready! Select how you would like to start interacting on your workspace."]
1: ["Initializing Workspace Integration", "Setting up companion animations and desktop overlay components..."]
2: ["Match With Your Ideal Desktop Companion", "Select traits that fit your daily desktop routines and workflow style."]
3: []
4: ["Sign In to Protect & Sync Your Pet", "Signing in links your pet companion securely to your cloud account so your progress is never lost.", "Use the email tied to your previous pet to retain existing customization and data."]
5: ["Rendering Your Desktop Companion...", "You can safely minimize this window. We'll send a notification as soon as your pet is ready on your screen."]
6: ["Setup takes under 2 minutes. You can adjust all preferences later from settings."]
7: ["Select Your Companion Onboarding Experience"]
8: ["Onboarding Complete! Collect Your Companion Starter Kit", "Claim your pet's first interactive desktop item to finish setup.", "Claim Free Companion Toy"]
9: ["Processing high-quality artwork assets for desktop rendering..."]
